critical_code_review_comments: demo_readiness.build() nests grants_authority under payload['authority']['grants_authority'] — the request text said top-level 'grants_authority false'. Behaviour is correct (never grants trading authority) and the readiness page explicitly states so, but UI consumers must read authority.grants_authority, not grants_authority.
A13-1 kill-switch correctly blocks live-intent accounts (via _wants_live) BEFORE constructing BinanceClient; paper/testnet accounts are not blocked.

A13-2 production_key_violation covers all four cases (missing / <32 / equal JWT_SECRET / valid distinct). token_hash raises RuntimeError in APP_ENV=production without BRIDGE_TOKEN_HASH_KEY. deploy_preflight.run_preflight() emits a 'bridge_hash_key' check.

Known pre-existing failures (per agent-to-agent note) were NOT re-tested and are not reported as new: test_iter181_deploy_preflight.py (needs replica set), test_iter136_security_hardening.py::test_bridge_token_rotation_grace, test_iter54_heartbeat_ws_mismatch.py.
